policy: Only a Chinese name read from a source is written into the atrocity layer. The 3.17 pass tried four routes in order: (1) every Chinese label variant Wikidata records for the entity, (2) the zh.wikipedia sitelink, (3) a Chinese Wikipedia search by the English name with every candidate introduction read before acceptance, (4) a batched zh interlanguage-link check on the English articles. A candidate is accepted only when its introduction documents the same event; a name resemblance is never enough.

wikidataLabelVariants.note: The 37 entities that already had a Chinese name also carry every variant; the other 256 have no Chinese label in any variant.

zhwikiSitelink.note: 27 entities have a zh.wikipedia sitelink and all 27 already carry a Chinese label, so the sitelink route adds nothing.

zhwikiSearch.note: The Chinese Wikipedia search endpoint answered 429 through repeated backoff at roughly two minutes per answered query, so only 5 of 256 queries completed before the sweep was stopped. The two incidents that returned candidates (Q2552587 -> 澳大利亚警察; Q1939243 -> 美国独立战争) are different topics and were rejected. Evidence: docs/verification-3.17/atrocities-zh-search.json.

zhInterlanguage.note: None of the 158 distinct English articles for the 256 unnamed incidents carries a zh interlanguage link.

conclusion: Chinese-name coverage stays at 37/293 (12.6%). The remaining 256 events have no Chinese source that names them, so nameZh stays null and they are counted in counts.withoutChineseName. No transliteration and no machine translation was used.
